test_title: PYST 06: SSC JE CE - General Awareness (Held on 07 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question:
Choose the correct statement/s from the following.

i. It is difficult to carry one's wealth under a barter system of transactions.

ii. Money is perishable and it cannot be stored.

iii. An increase in the price level can diminish the purchasing power of currency.
solution:
The correct answer is __**i and iii**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Under a **barter system**, it is indeed **difficult to carry one's wealth** because wealth is in the form of goods and services, which are **bulky and perishable**. This makes transactions cumbersome and inefficient. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
• Unlike many goods in a barter system, money is not perishable and can be stored over time without losing its value (except in cases of inflation). *Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.*
 
• An **increase in the price level (inflation) can diminish the purchasing power of currency**. This means that with higher prices, the same amount of money can buy fewer goods and services. *Hence, statement 3 is correct.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Barter System**__

 __
 
• The barter system is an ancient method of exchange where goods and services are traded directly without using money.
 
• One major drawback is the "double coincidence of wants" problem, where both parties need to have what the other wants.
 
 
 
• **Inflation**__
 __
 
• Inflation is the rate at which the general level of prices for goods and services rises, eroding purchasing power.
 
• Central banks attempt to limit inflation, and avoid deflation, to keep the economy running smoothly.
 
 
 
• **Currency**__
 
 
• Currency serves as a medium of exchange, a unit of account, a store of value, and sometimes, a standard of deferred payment.
 
• Unlike goods in a barter system, modern currency is durable and can be stored over time.
